why_next: Two physics packets in a row have now failed on the same structural feature, so a third redesign of the same criterion shape is a local optimum and the Director will not recommend it. The reason the second failure is not a retune problem is now known, not guessed: the null that the Global Research Director mandated - an independent within-stratum relabel of the true assignment - is COUNT-PRESERVING, so every statistic that depends on the treatment only through its label or its marginal distribution within stratum has displacement identically zero at any sample size. The packet's own three floating-point-zero deltas (4.44e-16, 1.11e-16, 1.11e-16) and its own code (execute_36302980957.py:661-673 the Product comparator is a pure function of r.assignment; :644-652 the Frontier endpoint ignores the assignment source) are that fact, and it is a negative about an entire FAMILY of gates rather than about one threshold. The mandate's whole purpose was to detect estimators that read only the treatment label, and a count-preserving relabel is structurally incapable of detecting a label-reader. Any gate that keeps the relabeling null as its discriminating object is therefore dead before it is written, and the productive move is to change the mathematical object, not the calibration. The proposed reframe does that: it asks whether the statistic carries out-of-sample information about the TARGET given randomized assignment, which is a different question, admits a standard identifiability argument, and is not defeated by count preservation because it never relabels anything. It also flips the relabeling null from the accept gate into a negative control with a known expected sign (a genuine target-reader must FAIL to reject it; a label-only reader must PASS it), which converts the instrument that was just invalidated into a test case with a predicted verdict. The two remaining accept-side requirements are the ones this packet violated and the mandate insisted on: a per-estimator threshold in the estimator's own units (a single scalar in bits applied to seven heterogeneous statistics is the defect that closed the parent packet and re-entered here through the MDD), and a pre-freeze power calculation with a real alternative distribution (IVC_POWER_AT_PLANTED 1.0 here is a 0/1 alias of the reachability boolean, and prereg sections 9.3 and 9.4 are literally 'TBD' in the frozen file). Requiring the accept branch to be shown reachable before freeze by TWO distinct target-readers rather than one also directly prevents the failure mode in which a gate is validated only by a single lucky estimator. This is a materially orthogonal question, not a rename: different null, different object, different power calculation, different predicted verdicts on the same battery.
